reported.title: Incorrect pulse duration
reported.description: The solenoid pulse duration is set to 1000 ms instead of the intended 2500 ms, causing the solenoid to activate for a shorter time than required.

reported.title: Missing pulse delay
reported.description: The pulse duration is not correctly implemented; the solenoid should be activated for 2500 ms, but the current implementation only activates it for 1000 ms.

truth.description: Solenoid pulse is 1 s not 2.5 s

truth_for_judge.description: Solenoid pulse is 1 s not 2.5 s

exposing_checks.behaviour: D8 pulse length around None ms (tolerance 200 ms) (2.5 s pulse)

judge_input.spec:
- Trigger on D2 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); glue solenoid on D8; armed LED on D11.
- A settled press as short as 30 ms starts a 2500 ms HIGH pulse on D8 within 120 ms.
- Retriggers during an active pulse are ignored.
- Debounce the trigger with 25 ms of stability.
- Keep D11 HIGH when idle and LOW while the solenoid pulse is active.
- Print `glue dots=<n> busy=<0|1>` every 500 ms.
